text_block_list.text:
в тренировке, Смарт Фалкон comes up
to me out
of breath...
Huff... puff... Trainer... What... should I... do?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
My fatigue isn't clearing up one bit...
There's no
way I can train cute like this!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... My muscles need to be cute and
healthy if
I want to be a top Umadol.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But when I'm this worn out, all I can do is
train
tired!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
She seems to be exhausted... Maybe I
need to
revise her race schedule.
